I am building this publication to explore mathematics, physics,
and scientific computing through careful research and clear explanations.

My interests include mathematical analysis, abstract algebra,
quantum mechanics, quantum cryptography, and computational modelling.

The aim is to make technical ideas accessible without sacrificing
mathematical precision.
